title: A trial places most of its test shards on a ready added host
description: A merge trial with one ready compute host reached through graphyard-host-shim, over test files that start servers and fetch URLs plus one that needs Docker. Only the Docker file stays on this machine; the rest run on the host, and master status's remoteShards shows most of the trial's shards run remotely with the host ready.

steps.name: Run a trial of network-word test files with one ready compute host
